events.body: ISM Manufacturing PMI in the United States is expected to rise from 53.3 in June to 54.0 in July
JOLTS Job Openings in the US are expected to decline slightly to 7.42m in June from 7.59m in May
Unemployment Rate in Australia is forecasted to tick higher from 5.3% to 5.4%
Weekly US Unemployment Claims are likely to increase to 205K from 197K in the previous week
Investors will closely monitor Non-Farm Payroll numbers from the US to gauge the Fed next move
